teaser.en: A flowering plant that lives its whole life underwater, it feeds dugongs and shelters the fish that Digo fishers catch.
teaser.sw: Ni mmea unaotoa maua na kuishi maisha yake yote chini ya maji; huwalisha nguva na kuwahifadhi samaki wanaovuliwa na wavuvi wa Kidigo.

summary.en: Narrowleaf seagrass is a true flowering plant that lives fully submerged in the sea, forming meadows on the intertidal sand flats. These meadows feed dugongs and turtles and shelter the fish, octopus and sea cucumbers on which coastal fishing depends.
summary.sw: Nyasi bahari hii yenye majani membamba (*narrowleaf seagrass*) ni mmea halisi unaotoa maua unaoishi ukiwa umezama kabisa baharini, ukiunda mbuga kwenye nyanda za mchanga zinazofunikwa na kufunuliwa na maji. Mbuga hizi huwalisha nguva na kasa na huwahifadhi samaki, pweza na majongoo bahari ambao uvuvi wa pwani unawategemea.

about.en:
Despite its name, seagrass is not a seaweed. It is a flowering plant, with roots, leaves and tiny flowers, that has adapted to living completely underwater. Narrowleaf seagrass has very thin, flat, ribbon-like leaves, only a millimetre or two wide, growing from creeping stems buried in the sand.

Where it grows thickly, it forms soft green meadows that sway in the current.
about.sw:
Licha ya jina lake, nyasi bahari si mwani. Ni mmea unaotoa maua, wenye mizizi, majani na maua madogo sana, ambao umejizoesha kuishi ukiwa chini ya maji kabisa. Nyasi bahari hii ina majani membamba sana, bapa na kama riboni, yenye upana wa milimita moja au mbili tu, yanayoota kutoka kwenye mashina yanayotambaa yaliyofukiwa mchangani.

Pale inapoota kwa wingi, huunda mbuga laini za kijani zinazoyumba katika mkondo wa maji.

where.en: It grows on the intertidal sand flats, where it is often exposed at the lowest tides. Seagrass meadows fringe Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni. Walk out across the flats at a spring low tide and you will see it carpeting the sand in shallow pools.
where.sw: Huota kwenye nyanda za mchanga zinazofunikwa na kufunuliwa na maji, ambapo mara nyingi huachwa wazi wakati wa maji kupwa kabisa. Mbuga za nyasi bahari huzunguka Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni. Tembea kwenye nyanda wakati wa bamvua la maji kupwa na utaiona ikitandika mchanga katika vidimbwi visivyo na kina.

uses.en: Seagrass meadows are nurseries and feeding grounds for the fish and animals that Digo fishers depend on: rabbitfish, parrotfish, octopus and sea cucumbers. The meadows also trap sediment, keeping the water clear and helping to protect beaches.
uses.sw: Mbuga za nyasi bahari ni malezi na malisho ya samaki na wanyama ambao wavuvi wa Kidigo wanawategemea: tafi, pono, pweza na majongoo bahari. Mbuga hizo pia hunasa mashapo, na hivyo kuweka maji safi na kusaidia kulinda fukwe.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. Swahili speakers usually call sea plants in general *mwani*. In English it is narrowleaf seagrass, and its scientific name is *Halodule uninervis*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Wazungumzaji wa Kiswahili kwa kawaida huita mimea ya baharini kwa jumla *mwani*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *narrowleaf seagrass*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Halodule uninervis*.

conservation.en: The seagrass meadows of Gazi Bay, Diani-Chale and Vanga-Shimoni are feeding grounds for dugongs, green turtles and rabbitfish, and nurseries for young fish. This is a favoured dugong food.
conservation.sw: Mbuga za nyasi bahari za Ghuba ya Gazi, Diani-Chale na Vanga-Shimoni ni malisho ya nguva, kasa na tafi, na malezi ya samaki wachanga. Hiki ni chakula kinachopendwa sana na nguva.

reason.en: Same family (Cymodoceaceae), grows in the same meadows
reason.sw: Familia moja (Cymodoceaceae), huota katika mbuga zilezile

reason.en: Another seagrass of the south coast flats
reason.sw: Nyasi bahari nyingine ya nyanda za pwani ya kusini
